content_units: A perfect slot does   not   exist for Berlin, London, New York, and Singapore with everyone inside   08:00-18:00 local time  , plus a   45-minute meeting   and   15-minute buffer before and after  .
- To keep   Singapore within 18:00 latest  , the meeting must start by   17:15 SGT
- That same moment is   11:15 Berlin  ,   10:15 London  ,   05:15 New York
- New York would be well   before 08:00
- To keep   New York at 08:00 earliest  , the meeting cannot start before   14:00 London / 15:00 Berlin / 21:00 Singapore
The best compromise is to minimize how far anyone falls outside the preferred   08:00-18:00   window while also respecting the Berlin blackout   12:00-13:30   and the 15-minute pre/post buffers.
Slot Rank   Berlin   London   New York   Singapore   Fit Notes
1     15:00-15:45       14:00-14:45       09:00-09:45       21:00-21:45     Best overall; only Singapore is outside, by 3h45
2     14:30-15:15       13:30-14:15       08:30-09:15       20:30-21:15     Slightly better for Singapore than later slots; all others fine
3     11:15-12:00       10:15-11:00       05:15-06:00       17:15-18:00     Best for Singapore, but New York is very early
4     13:30-14:15       12:30-13:15       07:30-08:15       19:30-20:15     Two participants slightly outside preferred hours
5     16:00-16:45       15:00-15:45       10:00-10:45       22:00-22:45     Comfortable for Europe/NY, toughest on Singapore
15:00-15:45 Berlin as the least bad choice
- Avoids the Berlin participant’s   12:00-13:30   no-meeting block
- Keeps   Berlin, London, and New York   comfortably inside working hours
- Pushes only   Singapore   outside the window, which is the unavoidable trade-off
Participant local times for the recommended slot
